name: cruise
description: Your Cruise key's models, budget and spend over MCP, a skill for choosing lanes and reading Cruise's refusals, and /cruise-setup for IDE BYOK. Agent CLI inference stays on Cursor — this plugin does not redirect it.

CRUISE_API_KEY.title: Cruise API key
CRUISE_API_KEY.description: A cru_ key for this machine. Prefer one that is rate-limited and scoped to the models you will use. Never paste a provider credential.

CRUISE_BASE_URL.title: Cruise base URL
CRUISE_BASE_URL.description: Origin only, no path. Production default; set https://cruise-demo.bytesbrains.net for the free demo.
